description: This file defines the class pBarcode39, which is used to generate barcode images (specifically Code 39). It includes methods for encoding data into barcode format, calculating size dimensions, and rendering the barcode graphical representation. It also loads a symbol database from an external data file during object construction.

classes.name: pBarcode39
classes.description: A class to create and render Code 39 barcodes, including encoding logic, size calculation, and drawing methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that loads the barcode symbol database and initializes class properties.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates the size (width and height) of the barcode for a given string and format options.

methods.name: encode39
methods.description: Encodes a string into the Code 39 barcode pattern and prepares the result string.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the barcode onto a given graphic object at specified coordinates with formatting options.

methods.name: checksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum character for a given string based on Code 39 specifications.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Returns the leftmost N characters of a string.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Returns the rightmost N characters of a string.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns a substring starting at a specified position with a specified length.
